script.narration: November 26, 1986. In a single afternoon, history changed forever. Iran–Contra affair: U.S. President Ronald Reagan announces the members of what will become known as the Tower Commission. The administration hoped to use the proceeds of the arms sale to fund the Contras, an anti-Sandinista rebel group in Nicaragua. Ronald Wilson Reagan was an American politician and actor who served as the 40th president of the United States from 1981 to 1989. Investigators, witnesses, and historians still study what unfolded at Warsaw, Poland decades later. Follow History Unsealed for tomorrow's unbelievable true story.
